title: DATEVALUE ( "Jan 31 2024" ) is 31 January 2024

source.quote: If you type a date as a string, DAX parses the string and tries to cast it as one of the Windows date and time formats
source.supports: text is read as a date when it matches a Windows date format
the operator reference compares a date with text of this form

derivation: DAX casts a date typed as a string using the Windows date formats, which in en-US accept an abbreviated month name, a day and a year. Jan 31 2024 reads as 31 January 2024.
alternative: No source lists the accepted formats or shows this one converted. If only numeric forms are accepted the query fails with a conversion error.
